landing.subtitle: Start with a trading idea. Understand your strategy through historical evidence, and make a more informed next move.
landing.methodIntro: Keep the research in one conversation. Form a hypothesis, replay the trades, and keep asking questions.
landing.desc1: Put your trading hypothesis into words and shape it into a clear strategy.
landing.desc2: Understand when historical trades happened, under which conditions, and with what results.
landing.desc3: Ask questions grounded in evidence and continue in the same workspace.
landing.footer: Historical results do not predict future performance.
landing.tag: For people who take research seriously.
